claim: When a figure may only have one colour (a wireframe ship model, a category), give all its pixels one colour-map key at bit 0 on a whole-figure sheet: one painted pixel then colours the whole figure.
limit: Needs the sheet with whole figures (unique=False): a unique painting sheet would show each key once, so one pixel per figure. Two colours painted on one figure: the first is kept and the read reports it.

evidence.text: Elite colours each ship model (blueprint in IY) and six draw categories; nexclash/elite_colours.py gives each figure one key, bit 0. A test sheet with one station pixel painted red recoloured the station byte only (0x3BC6 DB -> E0), and the redrawn sheet read back equal.
evidence.quote: one colour per ship model: each figure is one colour-map key at bit 0
